rationale: The candidate reads as one dominant stepped bar/courtyard mass across all views, so it is coherent and not view-dependent. The main strength is a clear hierarchy: a compact primary volume with a carved central void and a terraced upper portion. The parcel response is decent but not especially powerful; the mass sits inside the boundary and aligns generally with the site, yet it does not fully exploit the parcel as an open-space figure. The verified road edge is acknowledged, but the ground response remains somewhat sealed and blocky rather than strongly public-facing. The stepped silhouette is acceptable as a continuous section strategy, but it still trends toward stacked massing more than a distinctly inhabitable section. Programmatically, it can support neighborhood living / mixed-use reasonably well because it has a compact street edge and a void, but the public threshold and active ground condition are only moderate. Compared with the references, it resonates most with courtyard-driven neighborhood/commercial precedents, while the tower and bridge references are only weakly transferable.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: More enclosure-rich and cafe-driven than the candidate; transfer the courtyard/public-edge logic, not the exact spatial mood.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Compact street-facing massing with a carved interior openness and a legible public threshold.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Atmospheric landscape treatment is stronger than the candidate; avoid copying the scenic framing.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Strong indoor-outdoor room sequence and softened courtyard edge that supports neighborhood-scale public use.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Mostly interior/fit-out precedent; massing transfer is limited.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Small-scale active frontage with a simple, readable public interior edge.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Tall tower precedent is typologically distant from neighborhood living; only the ground/public-base lesson transfers.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Stacked massing can preserve a readable ground condition when the base remains distinct from the upper volume.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Counterfactual and typologically off for this compact neighborhood mass; do not emulate the bridge logic.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Elevated pedestrian continuity through a bridge-like connection.
